title: 第一章觉醒第二章面板第三章袖手
slug: 玄幻乱世猎户从箭术到人间武圣
content_zh:
天正十三年，十月十五，辰时初。
太阳藏在铅灰色的云层后面，天气格外阴沉，像是要下雨。
大齐青州长河县白沙镇，镇子东头背靠大青山的一处宅院，人们进进出出，颇为热闹。
屋内，传来了忽高忽低的哭声。
堂屋门口，一个十五六岁眉清目秀面色却有些苍白的少年背靠墙壁坐在地上睁开眼，一脸恍惚。
“顾晦……”
他皱着眉头，轻声念道。
这是他前世的名字，也是今生的名字。
前世四十来岁就遭遇意外，算是英年早逝，这一世才满十六岁，人生刚刚开始。
赚了？
只是，前世非常安稳，哪怕是底层百姓也不愁吃喝，努力一点，投胎投得好，还能实现所谓的梦想。
如今的世界，不太平啊！
“大郎，你醒了！”
一侧，一个三十多岁的妇人蹲在他身边，梨花带雨，用力地抓着他的肩膀。
“娘？”
顾晦扭头看了她一眼，轻声说道。
“大郎，你爹遭逢不幸，也不知能不能醒来，你千万不要有事啊！你若是走了……”
徐翠娘说不下去了，低头呜咽。
“阿兄！”
顾晦再次扭头。

另一侧，一个七八岁梳着双髻的丫头怯生生地望着他，苍白的小脸上滚满了泪珠。
这是他的妹妹顾瑜。
“阿兄没事……”
顾晦说道。
他的声音非常沙哑。
随后，他望向前方，堂屋的中间，几张长凳上面摆放着担架，上面躺着一个人，从镇子西边回春堂请来的郎中带着两个药童正在忙活。
地面有着一串血迹，从担架下的地上一直延伸到门口，担架下方的地面尤其密集，不过都已经干涸了，变成了紫黑色，它们来自躺在担架上的那个人，自己的父亲顾长青。
他是个猎户。
也是一个淬体不曾圆满勉强算是武道入门的武者，擅长箭术，打猎所获倒也能养活这一家四口。
今日一早，顾长青所在的打猎队上山打猎，途中，遭受了无妄之灾。
从郡城来的几个捉刀人在山间追杀黑榜通缉犯扑天鹤朱权，朱权冲入打猎队，以人为质，捉刀人们并没有顾忌这些人质，悍然冲杀过来。
神仙打架，凡人遭殃！
顾长青就是那个凡人！
受了重创鲜血淋漓昏迷不醒的他也就被抬回了家中，此时，躺在担架上的他还未醒来。
先前，郎中让顾晦上前帮忙。
content_en:
In the thirteenth year of Tianzheng's reign, it was the fifteenth day of the tenth month, the beginning of the Chen hour.
The sun was hidden behind leaden clouds, and the weather was extremely gloomy, as if it was going to rain.
In Baisha Town, Changhe County, Qingdao City, there is a house at the east end of the town with the back of Daqing Mountain. People are coming in and out, which is quite lively.
Inside the house, there were cries that came up and down.
At the door of the hall, a fifteen or sixteen-year-old boy with fair features but a somewhat pale complexion sat on the ground with his back against the wall and opened his eyes with a dazed look on his face.
"Gu Hui..."
He frowned and whispered.
This was his name in his previous life, and it is also his name in this life.
In the previous life, I met an accident when I was forty years old and died young. In this life, I was only sixteen years old and my life has just begun.
Earned?
However, the previous life was very stable. Even the people at the bottom did not have to worry about food and drink. If they worked hard and were reborn well, they could still realize their so-called dreams.
Today's world is not peaceful!
"Da Lang, you wake up!"
On one side, a woman in her thirties squatted beside him, holding his shoulders firmly.
"Mother?"
Gu Hui turned to look at her and said softly.
"Dalang, your father has encountered misfortune, and I don't know if he can wake up. You must not get into trouble! If you leave..."
Xu Cuiniang couldn't speak anymore, lowered her head and sobbed.
"Brother!"
Gu Hui turned his head again.
On the other side, a seven or eight-year-old girl with double buns looked at him timidly, her pale face covered with tears.
This is his sister Gu Yu.
"Brother, it's okay..."
Gu Hui said.
His voice was very hoarse.
Then, he looked forward. In the middle of the hall, stretchers were placed on several benches, with a person lying on them. The doctor invited from the Huichun Hall in the west of the town and two medicine boys were busy working.
There was a string of blood stains on the ground, extending from the ground under the stretcher to the door. The ground under the stretcher was especially dense, but it had dried and turned purple-black. They came from the person lying on the stretcher, his father Gu Changqing.
He is a hunter.
He is also a warrior who has not yet perfected his body tempering and can barely be considered a beginner in martial arts. He is good at archery, and his hunting harvest can support the family of four.
Early this morning, Gu Changqing's hunting team went up the mountain to hunt. On the way, they encountered an unexpected disaster.
Several knife-catchers from the county were chasing Zhu Quan, the wanted criminal on the black list, in the mountains. Zhu Quan rushed into the hunting team and took people hostage. The knife-catchers did not care about these hostages and rushed over brazenly.
When gods fight, mortals suffer!
Gu Changqing is that mortal!
He was seriously injured and bleeding and unconscious, so he was carried back home. At this time, he was still lying on the stretcher and had not yet woken up.
Previously, the doctor asked Gu Hui to come forward to help.
